analysis.method: Original PNG preserved. Read-only alpha>100 connected components and manually calibrated icon/FX source areas. Consumers use explicit rect/anchor; no source pixel edits.
analysis.clipRunsFormat: [y,x,width], source pixel coordinates RELATIVE to this frame rect, one-pixel-high horizontal strips. Main connected body plus two-pixel AA margin, other main bodies excluded. Cache Path2D once per frame; translate/scale with same rect anchor before clip and drawImage.
analysis.warning: Generated artwork has small inter-frame anatomy/feather variations. In-place eight-pose walk frames are distinct; smooth timing/blending and final human visual acceptance remain separate.

portraits.method: Read-only alpha>100 connected bodies; confirmed isolated 3x3 portraits, original pixels preserved.
